issues.description:
Method return type mismatch for Milkable.messageOnMilk():
- Problem statement (UML and textual description) declares Milkable.messageOnMilk() returns boolean (expects true/false to indicate milking success).
- Solution repository declares Milkable.messageOnMilk() with return type String, and Goat/Seal implementations return String messages (e.g., "Goat [name] is milked").
- Template Main prints the return value of messageOnMilk(), which is consistent with a printable value but ambiguous given the boolean in the problem text. This mismatch will either cause compilation errors (if tests expect a boolean) or incorrect behavior/assessments (if tests expect a String).
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one consistent return type for Milkable.messageOnMilk() across artifacts. Preferred fix (align to solution): update the problem statement and UML to declare messageOnMilk(): String and change the textual description to state that messageOnMilk() should return a milking message (for example: "[AnimalType] [name] is milked"). Alternative fix (align to problem text): change the solution to declare Milkable.messageOnMilk(): boolean and update Goat/Seal to return true/false and adjust any tests and example prints accordingly. Ensure all references (UML, textual instructions, template examples, and tests) are updated to the chosen return type.

issues.description: The method messageOnMilk() is described in the problem statement (UML and textual requirement) as returning a boolean (true if milking was successful, false otherwise). In the solution artifact, Milkable.java declares messageOnMilk() as returning String, and Seal.java and Goat.java implement it returning String values (e.g., "Seal <name> is milked"). This is a semantic/type mismatch for the same conceptual operation (milking) across artifacts and will confuse students: they will expect a boolean per the spec but the provided/solution code uses String, which can lead to compilation/test mismatches and unclear expectations about what the method should represent.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type for messageOnMilk() consistent across all artifacts. Two possible resolutions: (A) Preferred: Update the solution/template to match the problem statement by changing the interface to 'boolean messageOnMilk();' and update Seal and Goat to return boolean (e.g., true when milking succeeded). Update any code that prints or uses the value to handle a boolean (e.g., print a success/failure message based on the boolean). Also update tests/examples accordingly. (B) Alternatively, if the intended behavior is to return a descriptive String, update the problem statement (UML and textual descriptions) to specify that messageOnMilk() returns String (e.g., "<Animal> <name> is milked"). Ensure the chosen option is applied consistently in the interface, all implementations, the template usage, and the problem text.
